description: Data changes of ticket #7 (docs/specs/7-selection-facts.md): pa_application and pa_phase for the nine EcoFlow OCEAN 2 inverters created on 2026-10-07, the Application of SAJ H2-25K-T3/H2-30K-T3-DE and GoodWe ESA 20–30 kW as their manufacturers state it, the power figures of SAJ CHS2-29.9K-T4-X from its datasheet, and figures of the draft Pylontech PowerCubes X1/X2/H1/H2 (4123–4126) from their manuals in place of the 2022 Pylontech brochure (owner ruling 2026-10-09: the datasheet decides when product facts conflict; the products stay drafts; the PowerCube-M2A-180 draft 4127 was checked against its manual p.10 and agrees). "from" is the live value read on 2026-10-09; tools/migrate/7-facts.py applies "to" where it finds "from" and refuses on anything else.

new_attribute._source: As on the EcoFlow OCEAN 2 inverters already on the site (3555–3580, 2026-10-09): pa_phase at position 0, visible; pa_application at position 3, hidden.

pylontech-powercube-x2-p12.states: PowerCube-X1/X2-V2 Operation Manual, 2.3 System Specifications, column PowerCube-X2-V2: Battery System Capacity (kWh) 3.552 × n, Battery System Voltage (Vdc) 48 × n, Battery Charge Upper-Voltage (Vdc) 54 × n, Battery Module Discharge Lower-Voltage (Vdc) 43.5 × n (n = 2~10 H48074 modules), Rack 600*505*2130 mm (n = 2~10). The product is 5 × H48074 + SC0500-100S-V2 (its name and description), so n = 5: 17.76 kWh, 240 V, 217.5~270 V; per module 43.5~54 V; the rack is 600×505×2130 mm. Its name already says 17.76 kWh and stays.

pylontech-powercube-x2-p12.ruling: Owner, 2026-10-09: where product facts conflict, the product's datasheet decides ("以实际资料显示的数据为准"). 4124 was named 17.76 kWh while system_capacity_kwh_nominal said 24.9.
pylontech-powercube-x2-p12.states: The replaced figures cite pylontech_optim_us.pdf, which is in fact the 2022 Pylontech brochure ("2022Pylontech brochure-PY221107EN-SD"; archived under that name). Its p.30 is the PowerCube X series table (X1 336V50Ah, X2 336V74Ah: seven modules, 336 V, 315~378 V; X2 24.9 kWh, 600*505*1380 mm) with module voltage range 45~54 V; p.31 the PowerCube H series (H1 720 V, 664~810 V; H2 576 V, 531~648 V). The manuals give the discharge limit as 43.5 V per module. Its 24.9 kWh, 336 V, 315~378 V and 600*505*1380 mm are the seven-module X2, not this five-module product; the five figures that cite it are replaced.

pylontech-powercube-x1-p12.states: Column PowerCube-X1-V2: Battery Charge Upper-Voltage (Vdc) 54 × n, Battery Module Discharge Lower-Voltage (Vdc) 43.5 × n (n = 2~10 H48050 modules). The product is 7 × H48050 + SC0500-100S-V2, so 304.5~378 V; per module 43.5~54 V. Its 16.8 kWh, 336 V and 600×505×1300 mm (Rack 1, n = 2~8) agree with the manual and stay.
